items.source: Tag subclass of RollbackRuleAttribute that has the opposite behavior to the RollbackRuleAttribute superclass.
items.translation: `RollbackRuleAttribute` 的子类，其行为与 `RollbackRuleAttribute` 超类相反。

items.source: Create a new instance of the NoRollbackRuleAttribute class for the given exceptionType.
items.translation: 为给定的 `exceptionType` 创建一个新的 `NoRollbackRuleAttribute` 类实例。

items.source: Create a new instance of the NoRollbackRuleAttribute class for the supplied exceptionPattern.
items.translation: 为提供的 exceptionPattern 创建一个新的 NoRollbackRuleAttribute 类实例。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied exceptionType is not a Throwable type or is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的 exceptionType 不是 Throwable 类型或为 null

items.source: exceptionType - exception type; must be Throwable or a subclass of Throwable
items.translation: exceptionType - 异常类型；必须是Throwable或Throwable的子类

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied exceptionPattern is null or empty
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的 exceptionPattern 为 null 或为空
`toString` 在类 `RollbackRuleAttribute` 中

items.source: exceptionPattern - the exception name pattern; can also be a fully package-qualified class name
items.translation: exceptionPattern - 异常名称模式；也可以是完整的包限定类名
